mapper.select: SELECT EMPLOYEE_ID as employeeId, NAME as name, DEPARTMENT as department, POSITION as position, JOIN_DATE as joinDate, EMAIL as email FROM TB_EMPLOYEE WHERE EMPLOYEE_ID = #{identifier} OR NAME = #{identifier} FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT HISTORY_ID as historyId, COURSE_NAME as courseName, NCS_CODE as ncsCode, START_DATE as startDate, COMPLETION_DATE as completionDate, STATUS as status, SCORE as score FROM TB_EDUCATION_HISTORY WHERE EMPLOYEE_ID = #{employeeId} ORDER BY START_DATE DESC

SELECT SUBMISSION_ID as submissionId, COURSE_NAME as courseName, ASSIGNMENT_NAME as assignmentName, SUBMIT_DATE as submitDate, STATUS as status, CONTENT as content FROM TB_ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION WHERE EMPLOYEE_ID = #{employeeId} ORDER BY SUBMIT_DATE DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT RESULT_ID as resultId, SUBMISSION_ID as submissionId, GRADER_ID as graderId, SCORE as score, PASS_YN as passYn, FEEDBACK as feedback, GRADED_DATE as gradedDate FROM TB_GRADING_RESULT WHERE EMPLOYEE_ID = #{employeeId} ORDER BY GRADED_DATE DESC
